courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「軌道回路電阻帳」與「斷線與供電異常辨識」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Resistance accounting for the track circuit" and "Distinguishing disconnection and supply faults" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Electronic interlocking logic verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀；鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證則以互斥進路與狀態轉移的可驗證聯鎖為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation; Electronic interlocking logic verification centres on verifiable interlocking of conflicting routes and state transitions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「軌道回路電阻帳」與「聯鎖布林狀態空間」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「占用輸入守恆檢查」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Resistance accounting for the track circuit” and “Boolean interlocking state space”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Electronic interlocking logic verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Conservation checks for occupancy input", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation; Axle-counter train-occupancy detection centres on axle-count event conservation direction and data validity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「軌道回路電阻帳」與「區段軸數守恆」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到計軸器列車占用偵測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「未知占用狀態保存」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Resistance accounting for the track circuit” and “Axle conservation within a section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Axle-counter train-occupancy detection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Preserving unknown occupancy states", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌道電路列車占用偵測
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用輪對分流與漏電及乾濕與故障情境矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through wheelset shunts and leakage and dry wet and fault test matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「軌道回路電阻帳」到「誤占用維修履歷」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Resistance accounting for the track circuit" through "Maintenance history of false occupancy" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
